targetTexts.1: Be imitators of God, therefore, as beloved children,
targetTexts.2: and walk in love, just as Christ loved us and gave Himself up for us as a fragrant sacrificial offering to God.
targetTexts.3: But among you, as is proper among the saints, there must not be even a hint of sexual immorality, or of any kind of impurity, or of greed.
targetTexts.4: Nor should there be obscenity, foolish talk, or crude joking, which are out of character, but rather thanksgiving.
targetTexts.5: For of this you can be sure: No immoral, impure, or greedy person (that is, an idolater) has any inheritance in the kingdom of Christ and of God.
targetTexts.6: Let no one deceive you with empty words, for because of such things the wrath of God is coming on the sons of disobedience.
targetTexts.7: Therefore do not be partakers with them.
targetTexts.8: For you were once darkness, but now you are light in the Lord. Walk as children of light,
targetTexts.9: for the fruit of the light consists in all goodness, righteousness, and truth.
targetTexts.10: Test and prove what pleases the Lord.
targetTexts.11: Have no fellowship with the fruitless deeds of darkness, but rather expose them.
targetTexts.12: For it is shameful even to mention what the disobedient do in secret.
targetTexts.13: But everything exposed by the light becomes visible, for everything that is illuminated becomes a light itself.
targetTexts.14: So it is said: “Wake up, O sleeper, rise up from the dead, and Christ will shine on you.”
targetTexts.15: Pay careful attention, then, to how you walk, not as unwise but as wise,
targetTexts.16: redeeming the time, because the days are evil.
targetTexts.17: Therefore do not be foolish, but understand what the Lord’s will is.
targetTexts.18: Do not get drunk on wine, which leads to reckless indiscretion. Instead, be filled with the Spirit.
targetTexts.19: Speak to one another with psalms, hymns, and spiritual songs. Sing and make music in your hearts to the Lord,
targetTexts.20: always giving thanks to God the Father for everything in the name of our Lord Jesus Christ.
targetTexts.21: Submit to one another out of reverence for Christ.
targetTexts.22: Wives, submit to your husbands as to the Lord.
targetTexts.23: For the husband is the head of the wife as Christ is the head of the church, His body, of which He is the Savior.
targetTexts.24: Now as the church submits to Christ, so also wives should submit to their husbands in everything.
targetTexts.25: Husbands, love your wives, just as Christ loved the church and gave Himself up for her
targetTexts.26: to sanctify her, cleansing her by the washing with water through the word,
targetTexts.27: and to present her to Himself as a glorious church, without stain or wrinkle or any such blemish, but holy and blameless.
targetTexts.28: In the same way, husbands ought to love their wives as their own bodies. He who loves his wife loves himself.
targetTexts.29: Indeed, no one ever hated his own body, but he nourishes and cherishes it, just as Christ does the church.
targetTexts.30: For we are members of His body.
targetTexts.31: “For this reason a man will leave his father and mother and be united to his wife, and the two will become one flesh.”
targetTexts.32: This mystery is profound, but I am speaking about Christ and the church.
targetTexts.33: Nevertheless, each one of you also must love his wife as he loves himself, and the wife must respect her husband.
